name: Closed-Won Contract Audit (Path A — single Slack endpoint)

nodes.name: Slack Trigger (whole workspace)
nodes.notes: SINGLE endpoint — its URL is the Slack app's one Events request_url (.../webhook/a872a93b-.../webhook). Must watch the WHOLE workspace (not one channel), because Slack delivers message.channels for BOTH #closed-won and #sfdc to this one URL; a channel-scoped trigger would drop the other channel. The IF node filters down to the two channels.

nodes.name: IF: Rattle deal alert (either channel)
nodes.notes: Pass only: sender = Rattle (U05AA8MBV9B) AND channel ∈ {#closed-won C08JS7N86D6, #sfdc C0B88KMFJ3E} AND a *Name:* line exists. *Name:* is matched against the whole payload (JSON.stringify) because the deal fields live in message BLOCKS, not top-level text.

nodes.name: Call audit worker
nodes.notes: Path A: worker queries Salesforce itself (Spotdraft Bot needs View All on Opportunity + SpotDraft_Contract__c), runs the 16-check audit, posts in-thread + ✅ on clean. Worker reads channel_id from the event, so one pipeline serves both channels.
